title: UEREMCP Batch Plan
description: The `specification` payload for action=execute_plan. Batching is first-class (master prompt §2.3): one request, many dependent operations, one consolidated result. Owned by WS-05. Composes OVER Epic ProgrammaticToolset.execute_tool_script (preserve — WS-02 q7). $ref grammar final — see docs/proposals/ws-05-batch-ref-grammar.md and domains/_shared/result_ref.schema.json.

compile_policy.description: Compilation is expensive. 'at_boundaries' compiles only where a later operation depends on a compiled result — the pattern REAgentTools' NIAGARA_BATCHING.md found necessary. 'per_operation' is the slow, safe fallback.

on_failure.description: 'continue_independent' attempts operations that do not transitively depend on the failed one, and yields partially_completed. Maps to REAgentTools stop_on_error=false for the independent subset [VERIFIED: batch_workflow_tools.py:66-70].

id.description: Unique within the plan. Used by depends_on and by $ref result substitution.

action.description: Goal-level UEREMCP action, or an internal bridge action. Domain workstreams register actions; REAgentTools' 8-action allowlist is prior art for a *primitive* batch, not a ceiling on execute_plan [VERIFIED: batch_workflow_tools.py:17-26].

depends_on.description: Operation ids that must complete first. The executor topologically sorts; a cycle is rejected before ANY operation runs.

specification.description: Action-specific, same as the top-level envelope. May contain result $ref substitutions (object-form and/or dollar-string form — see domains/_shared/result_ref.schema.json).

optional.description: If true, failure does not fail the plan; it is reported and dependents are skipped.

condition.description: Run only if satisfied; otherwise the operation is skipped with a stated reason. Keeps agents from needing a round trip just to branch.

$comment: FINAL $ref grammar (2026-07-29). (1) Object form {"$ref":"<operation_id>.<dotted.path.into.response>"} is canonical for UEREMCP envelope paths. (2) Dollar-string "$<operation_id>" is accepted REAgentTools prior art [VERIFIED: batch_workflow_tools.py:37-48] resolving to result.primary_asset|label|path. Resolution failure fails the operation — never substitutes null. execute_plan composes OVER ProgrammaticToolset.execute_tool_script (preserve) [VERIFIED: WS-02 epic-toolsets.md q7]. Shared fragment: domains/_shared/result_ref.schema.json. Decision: docs/proposals/ws-05-batch-ref-grammar.md.
